text.body: mūṣikavāhana modakahasta cāmarakarṇa vilambitasūtra | vāmanarūpa maheśvaraputra vighnavināyaka pāda namaste || devadevasutaṃ devaṃ jagadvighnavināyakam | hastirūpaṃ mahākāyaṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabham || 1|| vāmanaṃ jaṭilaṃ kāntaṃ hrasvagrīvaṃ mahodaram | dhūmrasindūrayudgaṇḍaṃ vikaṭaṃ prakaṭotkaṭam || 2|| ekadantaṃ pralamboṣṭhaṃ nāgayajñopavītinam | tryakṣaṃ gajamukhaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ sukṛtaṃ raktavāsasam || 3|| dantapāṇiṃ ca varadaṃ brahmaṇyaṃ brahmacāriṇam | puṇyaṃ gaṇapatiṃ divyaṃ vighnarājaṃ namāmyaham || 4|| devaṃ gaṇapatiṃ nāthaṃ viśvasyāgre tu gāminam | devānāmadhikaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ nāyakaṃ suvināyakam || 5|| namāmi bhagavaṃ devaṃ adbhutaṃ gaṇanāyakam | vakratuṇḍa pracaṇḍāya ugratuṇḍāya te namaḥ || 6|| caṇḍāya gurucaṇḍāya caṇḍacaṇḍāya te namaḥ | mattonmattapramattāya nityamattāya te namaḥ || 7|| umāsutaṃ namasyāmi gaṅgāputrāya te namaḥ | oṅkārāya vaṣaṭkāra svāhākārāya te namaḥ || 8|| mantramūrte mahāyogin jātavede namo namaḥ | paraśupāśakahastāya gajahastāya te namaḥ || 9|| meghāya meghavarṇāya megheśvara namo namaḥ | ghorāya ghorarūpāya ghoraghorāya te namaḥ || 10|| purāṇapūrvapūjyāya puruṣāya namo namaḥ | madotkaṭa namaste'stu namaste caṇḍavikrama || 11|| vināyaka namaste'stu namaste bhaktavatsala | bhaktapriyāya śāntāya mahātejasvine namaḥ || 12|| yajñāya yajñahotre ca yajñeśāya namo namaḥ | namaste śuklabhasmāṅga śuklamālādharāya ca || 13|| madaklinnakapolāya gaṇādhipataye namaḥ | raktapuṣpa priyāya ca raktacandana bhūṣita || 14|| agnihotrāya śāntāya aparājayya te namaḥ | ākhuvāhana deveśa ekadantāya te namaḥ || 15|| śūrpakarṇāya śūrāya dīrghadantāya te namaḥ | vighnaṃ haratu deveśa śivaputro vināyakaḥ || 16|| phalaśruti japādasyaiva homācca sandhyopāsanasastathā | vipro bhavati vedāḍhyaḥ kṣatriyo vijayī bhavet || vaiśyo dhanasamṛddhaḥ syāt śūdraḥ pāpaiḥ pramucyate | garbhiṇī janayetputraṃ kanyā bhartāramāpnuyāt || pravāsī labhate sthānaṃ baddho bandhāt pramucyate | iṣṭasiddhimavāpnoti punātyāsattamaṃ kulaṃ || sarvamaṅgalamāṅgalyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam | sarvakāmapradaṃ puṃsāṃ paṭhatāṃ śruṇutāmapi || || iti śrībrahmāṇḍapurāṇe skandaprokta vināyakastotraṃ sampūrṇam ||
